paragraphs.text: The Western Desert is a desert in New Argive , part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria , although it might now have a newer name.
The desert was originally located in eastern Terisiare and was present as early as the last part of the Time of Legends .

The Western Desert received its name because it lay west of west from Argive and Korlis . It was divided from the Great Desert in the interior of Terisiare by the Kher Ridges . Come the Ice Age , the land froze over and became known as the Kjeldoran Hinterlands .

During the Thaw , the ice melted away, and Kjeldor became part of New Argive . The desert emerged once again and is present on modern-day maps, although it might go by a new name. The city of Toribah is located in the desert.
